messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

message.content:
At a pressure of 10 kPa (≈0.1 atm) pure water freezes at roughly **–2 °C**.  
The freezing point of water drops slightly as the external pressure falls below atmospheric pressure; at 10 kPa it is about 2 °C below the standard 0 °C freezing point at 101.3 kPa.
